selection: Mean four-feature autonomous full-sequence range-normalized absolute integral on validation; freeze before test
test: Frozen grouped rotation0 test fold; one final evaluation after selection freeze
training_balance: Equal configurations through inverse replica counts; remove old active/quiet transition reweighting to align with whole-sequence objective
evaluation: Configuration-balanced full histories; train-only normalization; no cone targets
history: Eight state samples ending at current time; repeat initial state for missing history, never future truth
architecture: GRU49->64; shared Linear64->64 + SiLU; four-delta and three-sigmoid-gate heads; fresh weights and optimizer
physics: No positivity, monotonicity or cessation constraints
burn_in: GRU memory initialized zero; teacher-forced prefix up to each training window recomputed with current parameters under no_grad; gradients within window only. Full autonomous evaluation uses predicted states from initial time, never true future states.
thermal_loss: Mean of all four physical-space normalized absolute integrals
scorecard: All four full-sequence integral percentages, old diagnostics retained
